# QWeather example fixtures

The JSON files in this directory are unchanged examples selected from the
official [`qwd/dev-site`](https://github.com/qwd/dev-site) repository at commit
`02bb257a032c503c65924005da6ebca48d94b390`. QWeather is their creator and the
documentation content is licensed under
[CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

They are retained only as deterministic template-contract test inputs. They are
not embedded in the `qweather` binary, used as runtime configuration, or treated
as an executable API registry. QWeather API service and data use remain subject
to the separate QWeather Developers terms.
